'''Hansh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitive]] member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Hansh fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, the group of mercenaries Hansh was with was attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

Hansh, along with [[Lergan]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] after attempting to flee from Darth Bane.
